title: Clock Skew
summary: Detects when a device clock is off from server time, says what breaks and corrects countdowns, so OTP codes and timers don't fail mysteriously.
description: Compares the device clock with server time (Date header or prop), says by how much and what breaks (authenticator codes, "expires in" timers, secure sites), corrects the countdowns inside it, and clears the warning once the clock is fixed.
catches: Device clocks ahead of or behind server time beyond a threshold
Authenticator codes that will be rejected because of the offset
"Expires in" timers that would show the wrong time
Clock fixes, by clearing itself when the offset goes away
limits: Accuracy is limited by the Date header's one-second resolution and network round-trip
Needs a server time source (prop or a measurable URL)
a11y: A role="region" with an aria-label from the title
"How to fix" toggle uses aria-expanded and aria-controls
stops: Wrong phone clock breaks OTP codes
